name: Fig Tree The
overview: The fig tree in Scripture symbolizes contrasting spiritual states, vividly illustrated in Jeremiah 24 where God reveals two baskets of figs: one with very good, first ripe figs representing the faithful remnant of Judah carried into captivity, and another with wicked, worthless figs that cannot be eaten, symbolizing the unrepentant and evil. This imagery highlights God's sovereign judgment and mercy, promising restoration and a renewed heart to those who return to Him wholeheartedly while exposing the fate of the wicked. The fig tree thus embodies both blessing and judgment, reflecting the condition of God's people and their relationship with Him.
